events.title: Book Nook Demo Update - Steam Next Fest Edition!
events.summary: Hey! To celebrate our participation in Steam Next Fest next week, we’ve been working hard on making Book Nook an even better experience. Here’s what’s new: Improved snapping system Connecting pieces now feels much more natural and satisfying. We’ve listened to your feedback and reworked the snapping so assembling your book nook is as relaxing as it should be. Leave us a review! You can now leave a review on Steam and it would mean the world to us. Every review helps us understand what’s working

events.title: Book Nook Demo Update!
events.summary: Hey everyone! Thank you so much for all the feedback since the demo launched . You really helped us make it better. Here's what's new:New tutorials:A tip now reminds you to aim for the connector to snap pieces into placeA tip now shows you how to hold left click to remove a piece — no more figuring it out by accident!Improvements:The overall gameplay feels smoother and more satisfyingAdded a level reset buttonSmall pieces now move closer to you so they're easier to see and grabBug fixes:Various

events.title: 20,000 wishlists in 48 hours! We can't believe it!
events.summary: Hi everyone! 20,000 wishlists in 48 hours. We can't believe it!! thank you so much for your support. And a huge thank you to Wholesome Direct for the visibility and for believing in us 🥹We've been reading every single comment in the discussions and we're already working on your suggestions. Keep them coming!Thank you. From all six of us Malapata Studio

events.title: Book Nook — World Premiere at Wholesome Direct + Demo Available Now!
events.summary: Hi there! We're so excited to finally share Book Nook with the world! Today we premiered at Wholesome Direct 2026 with a brand new trailer, and our demo is available now on Steam. Official Teaser Book Nook is a satisfying puzzle game about the joy of building something with your own hands. Piece by piece, you'll craft tiny little corners full of life. We made as a love letter to our favourite Book Nooks. We really hope you feel that when you play it 🥹 Download the demo, jump into our Player Feed
